display_name: These questions are about how you feel and how things have been with you during the past 4 weeks. For each question, please give the one answer that comes closest to the way you have been feeling.
description:
How much of the time during the past 4 weeks... a) Have you felt calm and peaceful? [Rand Health Care. 12-Item Short Form Survey (SF-12)](https://www.rand.org/health-care/surveys_tools/mos/12-item-short-form.html)
